overall_notes: The paper focuses on Speech Translation Quality Estimation (SpeechQE) as a distinct task from text-based MT quality estimation. It evaluates both cascaded and end-to-end systems for predicting quality scores and error spans. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and removal of redundant items.
